comparison.interpretation: Descriptive matched-seed development comparison. Actions change subsequent simulated learner responses; the closed-loop transcripts are not fixed across arms. Histories share six concept cards and persona/family templates. No population confidence interval or human learning claim is made for the between-arm changes.

quality_decision: Correctness improved; no simulator learning-quality improvement. Autonomous outreach increased and mean hidden mastery slightly decreased. Keep the logical fix; do not select additional interventions or requalify the full system from this study.
